culture-cycles.note: The patron-saint day is a school holiday in this state. The ministry lists it apart from the statutory public holidays, so do not assume shops or businesses close; the ministry page does not say.

laws.rule: Styria's overnight levy (Nächtigungsabgabe) is set by state ordinance LGBl. 75/2026 for stays from 1 December 2026: EUR 1.70 per person per night in alpine huts and shelters, EUR 2.20 on camping, caravan, motorhome and mobile-home pitches, and EUR 2.80 in all other accommodation (about A$2.70, A$3.50 and A$4.45 at EUR 0.6293 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026), section 1(1). The earlier ordinance amounts apply until then.
laws.heading: Festsetzung der Nächtigungsabgabe, LGBl. 75/2026, section 1

laws.rule: Under section 1(3) of the Steiermärkisches Landes-Sicherheitsgesetz, a municipality may issue an ordinance banning tents, caravans, motorhomes and similar mobile shelters outside campsites, at set places or across the whole municipality. The ordinance must say when the ban does not apply, for example with the landowner's consent. Whether the ban applies depends on the municipality, so check the local ordinance.
laws.heading: Stmk. Landes-Sicherheitsgesetz, section 1(3) (RIS Landesrecht)

laws.rule: Under section 1(2) of the Steiermärkisches Landes-Sicherheitsgesetz, a municipality may ban drinking alcohol on named public streets and squares by ordinance where it is needed to prevent noise or disorder from drinking. The ordinance says when the ban does not apply, for example approved events or licensed service. Styria itself sets no state-wide street-drinking ban.
laws.heading: Stmk. Landes-Sicherheitsgesetz, section 1(2) (RIS Landesrecht)

laws.rule: Styria: minors may be in public places, businesses and club rooms and at events without a supervising person: up to the end of the 14th year 05:00 to 23:00; to the end of the 16th year 05:00 to 01:00; from 16 without limit. This is a maximum frame, and the parents decide how much of it is used (section 15 of the Steiermärkisches Jugendgesetz). Going past the times is an offence for the young person (section 27(2)).
laws.heading: Stmk. Jugendgesetz, sections 15 and 27

laws.rule: Styria: up to the end of the 16th year, buying, having and drinking alcohol is banned; up to 18 the same applies to spirits and spirit-based mixed drinks, and to tobacco and related products, other nicotine products and devices such as water pipes and tobacco heaters (section 18(1) and (2) of the Steiermärkisches Jugendgesetz).
laws.heading: Stmk. Jugendgesetz, section 18
